visualCharacteristics.structure: h1 + description + color palette rows (swatch, name link, placement) + Add palette to project pill | room photo
visualCharacteristics.layout: From 1024px a 4/8 two-column grid: text column left (h1, description, palette rows pushed to the bottom with thin rules between them, full-width black pill "Add palette to project +"), room photo right with 24px rounded corners (3:2 from 1200px, 1:1 at 1024-1199px). Below 1024px stacked with the photo first (2:3 mobile, 1:1 tablet, 16px radius). The photo is the LCP image (eager, high priority). The pill adds every card color to My Projects (scripts/projects.js); once all are saved it reads "Palette added" and a second click removes them (aria-pressed).

contentPattern: row 1: [h1 headline + p description]; row 2: [picture] | [ul of colors, each li = CODE|Name|HEX + placement text (e.g. ' Wall')]
